name: 95337 · Manteca, CA
findings: ZIP 95337 (Manteca) has 78 nonprofit organizations. 28 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95337 (Manteca) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 95337 (Manteca) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 44% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 46 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.
